We are so proud to celebrate our October Member of the Month, Yasmin! Yasmin has always been incredibly consistent and dedicated to her fitness journey, but we admire her commitment even more as she prepares to welcome her baby! She joined SWEAT440 because she wanted to find a workout routine she could truly stick with, and the convenience of having a class every 10 minutes has made it easy to fit fitness into her busy schedule. She has set an amazing goal of reaching 1,000 classes before giving birth, and we’ll be cheering her on every step of the way. Yasmin, we are so proud of you and everything you’ve accomplished! We can’t wait to watch you hit that incredible 1,000-class milestone and, of course, meet your little one 🫶🏼✨

🎉 October Member of the Month🎉

Peter didn’t walk into SWEAT440 just looking for a workout—he was looking for a way to feel like himself again. After struggling with hip issues and spending a year and a half at another gym without seeing the progress he wanted, everything changed when he found SWEAT440. Within just 3 months, he felt stronger, moved better, had more energy, and started seeing real results. Two years later, at 42, Peter says he’s in the best shape of his life—and that’s more than a physical transformation. It’s the confidence that comes from knowing what your body is capable of when you refuse to give up🥂🦾💙

Congratulations Peter🔥 Keep showing up for yourself💯

Congratulations @ma.soledad.acuna our SWEAT440 member of the month At 63, after being diagnosed with osteoporosis, she realized that strength and resistance training needed to become an important part of her life. Having never trained this way before, joining SWEAT440 in May was a big step toward becoming stronger and healthier.
What keeps her motivated is the variety of the workouts—every class is different, dynamic, and challenging. She especially values the genuine care and support she receives when exercises need to be adapted to her needs, along with the incredible energy from Eduardo and coaches Roy, Patrick, and Oscar.
Today, SWEAT440 means more than just working out. She leaves each class feeling stronger physically and emotionally, and most importantly, feels she is in the right place with the right people by her side. #memberofthemonth #hiit #fitnessmotivation

OCTOBER MEMBER OF THE MONTH 💥 
.
Meet Catherine! One of our newer members, she always has a huge smile and positive energy first thing in the morning! We asked her a few questions about her time with us so far, and here’s what she said:

“When I first came to SWEAT440, I had been searching for a gym that truly felt like home. I wanted to feel welcomed, supported, and confident that I could safely challenge myself despite my back, neck, and shoulder issues. After struggling to find the right fit, I started wondering if I would ever feel like myself again—strong, healthy, and happy in my own body.  Everything changed when I found SWEAT440. From the very beginning, Brianna and the coaching team made me feel like I belonged. They listened to my limitations, gave me modifications when I needed them, and still found ways to challenge me. They saw what I was capable of, even when I didn’t see it in myself.  A few weeks ago, I realized just how much had changed. My coaches began encouraging me to lift heavier and push myself further because they knew I was ready. Their belief in me helped me believe in myself.  Fourteen weeks later, I’m stronger, healthier, happier, and more confident. I actually look forward to waking up at 4:20 a.m. to work out with coaches I now consider friends. But the biggest change extends far beyond the gym: I believe in myself and what I’m capable of.  I feel like myself again.”

Huge congratulations to @saraandjacksmom

Have you met Coach Carlos?

One of the new faces around Highland, Carlos was born in Mexico and raised right here in Austin. 

His own fitness journey showed him how much confidence and discipline can come from training—and now he loves helping others experience the same.

His coaching style? Supportive, encouraging, and focused on helping you get stronger one workout at a time.

🏋️ Favorite workout: Strength training + endurance challenges

🎾 Outside the studio: Tennis, soccer, biking, and time with his niece and nephew

🍗 Favorite food: Wings, of course

⚡ Fun fact: He has enough energy drinks in his fridge to open a convenience store

His advice: Don’t focus on being perfect. Focus on doing your best.
